note: Expected contents of opening a pack or sealed product, minus the product price. History-based estimates from dated pull rates and our singles prices. Not advice.

method.pullRates: data/pull-rates.json. A row is written only when the source states the rate, with its link and date.
method.bulkFloor: Trimmed mean of Common and Uncommon on asOf, times 9 cards per pack. Under 20 prices, the median is used. The median is stored beside the mean.
method.rareSlot: Median Rare / Holo Rare / Double Rare in the set × 1 rare slot per pack.
method.packs: booster-pack=1, booster-bundle=6, booster-box=36, ETB=9 (SWSH=8), PC-ETB same as ETB.
method.monteCarlo: 10000 sims; each published rarity rate is an independent draw at that slot's average price.
method.promo: Fixed promo/contents not yet in the sealed products file; promo=0 for this build.
method.copy: Public label is Rip value. EV and ROI % are history-based estimates.
method.rerun: Every product that still scores was rescored with the trimmed-mean bulk floor and a seeded Monte Carlo. A product that was not already in the file is included only when it has a TCGplayer market price. A daily history file is written beside this one.
